title: How to File for Divorce in Illinois (2027): Fees & Steps
rank_math_title: How to File for Divorce in Illinois (2027): 90 Days, No Wait
rank_math_description: Illinois divorce 2027: 90-day residency, no waiting period, no-fault only, $388 Cook County fee, joint simplified dissolution and the maintenance formula.
focus_keyword: how to file for divorce in illinois
pdf_outline: Checklist: 90-day residency -> joint simplified (8 conditions) or regular petition -> financial affidavits -> e-file ($388 Cook) / fee waiver -> service or appearance ($250) -> MSA (+ parenting plan within 120 days, UOS) -> parenting class -> prove-up -> judgment
Box: maintenance formula worked example (payor net $80,000, payee net $30,000 -> 33.3% x 80k - 25% x 30k = $19,167; cap 40% of $110k minus $30k = $14,000 -> $14,000/yr)
